name: States of Austria
author: Addicting Games
description: States of Austria is a geography game that will help increase your knowledge of Austria! Whether you are a geography nerd or if you are completely lacking in the geography department, then check out this educational game. There are only 8 states of Austria that you need to memorize to win in this online game. Find states of Austria like Karten, Tirol, Steiermark, and others. Play until you get each one right without any errors proving you are the map expert! This online game teaches you as you go because it is all about education. Even if you get the answer wrong, it will show you the name of the state you did select. Additionally, it will show you the right answer if you get it wrong 3 times. With this educational game, you can play it over and over again until you completely nail it keeping all 100 of your points.
